data.description:
## Context

Historical audit (analysis ticket b902-18af-14ed-4da1): of 894 BLOCK→re-review transitions, 13-14% re-blocked ONLY on the same persisting criteria — the author re-submitted without addressing the outstanding findings, paying a full review (~$3-7) to learn nothing new. A staged-LLM re-review was modeled and rejected (net negative: 45% of re-reviews PASS and would pay an extra serial call). The approved compromise is a zero-LLM deterministic pre-check, WARN-ONLY (operator decision 2026-08-11): it must never hard-block, because ~8% of BLOCK→PASS flips occur with no material change at all (verdict flap) and a hard decline would freeze those recoveries. This mirrors the escape-hatch posture of the shipped BLOCK-verdict-reuse (`plan_review/reuse.py`).

## Plan

1. When `review-plan` runs on a ticket whose LATEST attested verdict is BLOCK with recorded blocking findings, extract each blocking finding's cited evidence anchors (the finding's `evidence` strings and quoted plan fragments recorded in the sidecar).
2. DET check (no LLM): compare the current plan material against the material fingerprinted at the blocking review. If the plan text containing every cited anchor is UNCHANGED (all anchors still present verbatim and description component fingerprint unchanged per `material_parts`), print a WARNING before the review runs: the outstanding blocking findings cite text the revision did not touch, naming the findings and their criteria, and noting the review will likely re-block. Then RUN THE REVIEW ANYWAY (warn-only; no new flag, no decline, no exit-code change).
3. Anchors that cannot be matched verbatim (paraphrased evidence, structural findings with no quote) are treated as unmatchable and NEVER trigger the warning on their own — the warning fires only when at least one anchor matched the old text AND all matched anchors are untouched.
4. Record `precheck.cited_anchor_warning: true|false` in the review's sidecar metrics so the warning's hit rate and predictive value are measurable offline (per ADR 0054).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Re-reviewing a ticket whose plan is unchanged since a BLOCK (same description component fingerprint) prints the warning naming the persisting findings' criteria, and the review still runs to a verdict. Verify: `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -m pytest tests/unit -k "cited_anchor" -x` passes with a test pinning warning text + review execution.
- [ ] Re-reviewing after an edit that changed cited text does NOT warn. Verify: covered in the same test module.
- [ ] Findings with no verbatim-matchable anchors never trigger the warning alone. Verify: covered in the same test module.
- [ ] The sidecar metrics block records the warning flag on every plan review. Verify: unit test pins the field.
data.title: Warn-only DET cited-anchor pre-check before re-reviewing an unaddressed BLOCK
